type M = { [K in 0 | "0"]: number };
type ByString<T extends M> = T["0"];
type ByNumber<T extends M> = T[0];
const x: ByString<M> = 1;
const y: ByNumber<M> = 2;
console.log(x, y);

type Named = { [K in "a" | "b" as K extends "a" ? 1 | "1" : K]: string };
type First<T extends Named> = T["1"];
type Second<T extends Named> = T[1];
const s: First<Named> = "one";
const t: Second<Named> = "uno";
console.log(s, t);

const u = Symbol("u");
type WithSymbol<T extends { [u]: number }> = T[typeof u];
type ByIndex<T extends { [k: symbol]: number }> = T[symbol];
const v: WithSymbol<{ [u]: number }> = 3;
const w: ByIndex<{ [k: symbol]: number }> = 4;
console.log(v + w);
